title: lathyrus ochraceus subsp. occidentalis
intro: Lathyrus ochraceus subsp. occidentalis, commonly known as Western pea, is a perennial legume that belongs to the Fabaceae family. The plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and alleviate symptoms associated with arthritis and other inflammatory conditions. The therapeutic actions of Western pea are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which have been shown to exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. Furthermore, the plant has been traditionally used to treat various ailments, including fever, cough, and skin conditions, due to its therapeutic actions.
